name: @hheei/pi-subagents
description: Independent background Pi subagent sessions with durable identity and RPC control.

scripts.build: node -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('dist/mcp', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('src/mcp/app.html', 'dist/mcp/app.html'); chmodSync('dist/mcp-stdio.js', 0o755)"
